chapters.reason: The paper analyzes shallow layers in transformers, showing they capture specific, local, and syntactic patterns (e.g., textual n-grams), aligning with the description of shallow layers as basic representational processors for surface-level information.

The paper discusses upper (deep) layers learning more semantic patterns and refining outputs through residual connections to produce final distributions, matching the role of deep layers in output refinement and decision-making.

The paper examines distinct computational roles of feed-forward layers across depths (e.g., shallow vs. semantic patterns), corresponding to micro-level observations of functional differentiation between layers in reasoning processes.
